messages:
ellie: Hey team — Lina's birthday is next Tuesday. Thinking a tiny hybrid celebration. Quick poll: morning pastries (8:30-9), afternoon tea (3-4), or a surprise lunchtime card (12:15)? Also picking snack style: cupcakes / donuts / fruit platter. Remote folks get a virtual card. Can people add what they can bring to the sign-up doc? https://tinyurl.com/lina-bday

noah: Morning pastries for me, can bring vegan muffins :thumbsup:

tasha: Afternoon tea is better on my side but I can try to make morning work. I can bring a box of assorted teas + napkins.

people-ops-bot: POLL created by ellie: When should we celebrate? Options: 1) Morning pastries 2) Afternoon tea 3) Lunchtime card. Vote with :one: / :two: / :three:

maria: voted :two: — also low-key prefer cupcakes over donuts if folks are choosing snacks

sam: Donuts please, happy to pick up a dozen from Sprinkles if that helps. I can do morning or lunch.

ellie: Updated the doc with slots and dietary column — pls add any allergies. Simplified link: https://tinyurl.com/lina-bday (just add your name next to an item)

zoe: Remote — I'll send the virtual card + a silly GIF on Tuesday morning :confetti_ball:

tasha: Could we do both morning pastries and a quick lunchtime card drop? Short and sweet — pastries at 8:45, 5–10 min card at 12:15?

noah: I can do that plan. Muffins in the AM and help with the card at lunch.

ellie: Sounds good. Final plan (for now): Morning pastries 8:45 in pantry area, quick lunchtime card & group photo at 12:15. Snacks: vegan muffins (noah), cupcakes (maria), donuts (sam) + fruit platter fallback. Please annotate the doc if you're bringing anything else. Thanks everyone :partyparrot:

sam: 🎉 Count me in, will bring extra napkins and coffee cups.

maria: I'll label the cupcakes (contains eggs/dairy) and bring small plates.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set for Tuesday 8:15 and 11:50 for the card.

ellie: Appreciate it all — Lina is going to love it. If anyone remote wants to drop a short voice note for the card, DM me and I'll stitch it into the doc.
